hard_stops.rule: Never read GPIO1 or set FEATURE_BATTERY_MONITOR != 0 (no divider soldered, prevents bootloop).
Never set FEATURE_AUDIO != 0 (no I2S DAC soldered, prevents DMA hang).
Never set FlashMode to OPI (requires FlashMode=qio, PSRAM=opi) or touch PSRAM pins GPIO 33-37 / strapping pins GPIO 0, 3, 45, 46.
